stickers.name: Basic AF
stickers.blurb: Fifty kills with the plain old Fire Missile. Nothing fancy. Nothing needed.

stickers.name: No Place Like Home
stickers.blurb: Fifty kills with homing missiles. Click your heels and let the rocket drive.

stickers.name: Straight Shooter
stickers.blurb: Fifty kills with the Power Missile. No curve, no mercy.

stickers.name: Tailgunner
stickers.blurb: Fifty kills with rear missiles. Never look back. Shoot back.

stickers.name: What's Mine Is Yours
stickers.blurb: Fifty kills with land mines. You left a little something behind.

stickers.name: Pepper Shaker
stickers.blurb: Fifty machine-gun kills. Season to taste.

stickers.name: Backyard BBQ
stickers.blurb: Fifty kills by fire. Bring your own buns.

stickers.name: Shock Therapy
stickers.blurb: Fifty kills by electricity. Doctor's orders.

stickers.name: Grille Kill Kult
stickers.blurb: Fifty kills with your front end. The grille remembers every face.

stickers.name: Gotta Crash 'Em All
stickers.blurb: Finished the tour in every ride on the lot.

stickers.name: Special Delivery
stickers.blurb: Scored a kill with every signature special in the lot. Sign here.

stickers.name: Day Tripper
stickers.blurb: Finished the tour on a Learner's Permit.

stickers.name: Long Hauler
stickers.blurb: Finished the tour as a Road Raging Commuter.

stickers.name: Road King
stickers.blurb: Finished the tour on a Revoked License. Bow down.

stickers.name: Student Driver
stickers.blurb: Passed Driver's Ed. The state already regrets it.

stickers.name: I Brake For Nobody
stickers.blurb: A hundred pedestrians and critters. The tire tracks tell the story.

stickers.name: My Other Car Is Also Totaled
stickers.blurb: Totaled twenty-five times. Your insurer stopped calling.

stickers.name: Thelma and Louise
stickers.blurb: Drove off the edge twenty-five times. Hold hands next time.

stickers.name: Under da Sea
stickers.blurb: Sank in deep water twenty-five times. Darling, it's better.

stickers.name: Target Practice
stickers.blurb: Shot to scrap twenty-five times. The other drivers thank you for your service.
